item.title: There's already a condom shortage at the Winter Olympics
item.description: CORTINA D’AMPEZZO, ITALY – FEBRUARY 05: A general view of the Olympic Rings at the Cortina d’Ampezzo Olympic Village on February 5, 2026 in Fiames, Italy. The Cortina d’Ampezzo Olympic Village will serve athletes and team officials joining in alpine skiing, bobsleigh and other events. It features 24-hour dining services, fitness training areas, medical stations, and public gathering spaces, and will welcome participants from around the world during the Winter Games.
